value.name: Professional Digital Soldering Station
value.description: High-precision digital soldering station with temperature control, rapid heating, and an ergonomic heat-resistant handle.

introduction.overview: The Weller Digital Soldering Station is designed for professional technicians and hobbyists alike. It offers precise temperature regulation, dynamic heat recovery, and a digital LCD panel to display real-time telemetry. Its compact size ensures it fits neatly on any workbench.
introduction.purpose: Provide highly stable and controllable thermal energy for delicate surface-mount components (SMD) and through-hole soldering tasks.
features: Digital LCD screen for precise temperature control and adjustment
Fast heating element reaching 350°C in less than 30 seconds
Automatic standby and sleep modes for energy efficiency and tip protection
Password lock feature to lock custom temperature settings
Heat-resistant silicon cable and ergonomic handpiece with soft grip
applications: SMD and through-hole electronic component repair
Wire splicing and cable connector terminations
Small metal crafts and jewelry repair
advantages: Accurate temperature control prevents heat damage to sensitive components
Extremely quick heat-up reduces idle time on the workbench
Includes auto-cooling and timeout features to increase safety
Compatible with a wide range of official Weller soldering tips

shipping_list.name: Safety Iron Stand with Brass Sponge Holder

value.name: Precision Hot Air Rework Station
value.description: Professional closed-loop hot air station for desoldering QFP, SOP, PLCC, and BGA components safely.

introduction.overview: The Quick Precision Hot Air Rework Station uses an advanced brushless fan system to provide smooth, high-volume hot air flow. The closed-loop temperature control allows precise thermal adjustments, making it the perfect choice for professional surface mount component repair.
introduction.purpose: Provide uniform, contact-free hot air stream to desolder and rework complex IC packages and small SMD parts.
features: Brushless vortex motor for super silent and uniform airflow
Sensor closed loop temperature control with high power output
Automatic cooling function to protect heating element lifespan
Includes three specialized round nozzles (5mm, 6.4mm, 8mm)
Digital readout display for precise airflow and temperature monitoring
applications: Desoldering BGA, QFP, SOP, PLCC and SOIC chips
Plastic molding and warming test operations
advantages: No direct contact prevents scratching or moving adjacent tiny SMDs
Closed loop sensors maintain exact temperature regardless of air speed
Excellent build quality built for continuous industrial/lab usage

value.name: Ergonomic Flush Wire Cutters
value.description: Ultra-sharp precision flush cutters for clean, close cutting on copper and soft wires. Crafted with high-grade carbon steel.

introduction.overview: Knipex Super Knips are professional-grade electronic wire cutters. With precision-ground cutting edges without bevel, they ensure smooth flush cutting on components and circuit boards. High-comfort handles reduce hand fatigue during long assembly sessions.
introduction.purpose: Cut delicate copper, component leads, and soft wire flush to the board surface without transmitting shock to the solder joints.
features: Precision-ground blades with micro cutting-edge offset for extreme longevity
Extremely smooth movement with friction-free return spring
Constructed with hardened surgical steel with high corrosion resistance
Two-component multi-grip sleeves for maximum hand ergonomics
Includes wire lead catcher to prevent clippings from flying
applications: Cutting components leads on through-hole printed circuit boards
Trimming copper wire up to 1.6mm diameter
Trimming plastic components and cable ties
Delicate model making and structural prototypes
advantages: No bevel design yields a perfectly flat cut right at the PCB surface
Extremely long-lasting sharpness compared to standard hardware cutters
Handy wire catcher keeps workspace neat and safe

value.name: Auto-Ranging Digital Multimeter
value.description: Compact True-RMS multimeter for field service technicians, featuring auto-ranging, voltage detection, and backlit display.

introduction.overview: The Fluke 115 Digital Multimeter is the go-to testing companion for electrical and electronic troubleshooters. Featuring an intuitive interface, True-RMS AC measurements, and high safety certification, it delivers reliable readings every single time.
introduction.purpose: Perform troubleshooting, testing, and measurements on AC/DC voltage, resistance, current, continuity, and capacitance.
features: True-RMS measurements for accurate readings on non-linear loads
Large, highly visible white LED backlit display for dark areas
Low input impedance (LoZ) to prevent false ghost readings
Resistance, continuity, frequency, and capacitance measurements
CAT III 600 V safety rated for commercial and industrial use
applications: Circuit troubleshooting and power supply verification
Continuity testing in cables, wires, and circuit traces
Automotive electrical testing and appliance repairs
advantages: Rugged external holster shields against impacts and 2m drops
Auto-ranging feature automatically selects the best measurement resolution
True-RMS makes it accurate on modern complex wave forms

shipping_list.name: TL75 Hard Point Test Lead Set

value.name: Mixed Domain Digital Oscilloscope
value.description: 4-Channel 100MHz digital oscilloscope with large screen, built-in waveform generator, and serial decoding capabilities.

introduction.overview: The Rigol DS1104Z Plus is an extremely popular 4-channel digital oscilloscope. Boasting a 100MHz bandwidth and a deep memory depth, it provides detailed visualization of high-speed signals. Perfect for debugging microcontrollers, SPI/I2C buses, and analog circuits.
introduction.purpose: Graphically display electrical voltage waveforms over time to analyze signal behavior, integrity, and noise.
features: 4 analog channels with 100 MHz bandwidth
1 GSa/s real-time sample rate on single channel
Innovative UltraVision technology for intensity graded display
Deep memory depth up to 24 Mpts for zooming into detail
Free serial bus trigger and decode package (I2C, SPI, RS232, UART)
applications: Measuring signal noise, rise/fall times and frequency jitter
Analyzing analog filters and amplifier circuits
Education labs and digital design prototyping
advantages: 4 channels allow viewing input, output, and multiple communication lines simultaneously
Large 7-inch TFT color display makes tracking multiple waveforms easy
Rich trigger menu including edge, pulse, slope, video, and pattern options

value.name: Linear Triple Output DC Power Supply
value.description: Highly stable, low ripple linear DC power supply with three independent channels, total 195W power, and programmable USB control.

introduction.overview: The DP832 is a triple-channel, high-performance programmable linear DC power supply. Featuring low ripple and noise, rapid transient response, and excellent line/load regulation, it is an essential instrument for powering sensitive circuits.
introduction.purpose: Deliver clean, regulated, adjustable DC voltage and current to electronic projects and devices during testing.
features: 3 isolated channels: 30V/3A, 30V/3A, and 5V/3A
Extremely low ripple and noise: < 350 µVrms / 2 mVpp
Fast transient response time: < 50 µs
Built-in overvoltage (OVP) and overcurrent (OCP) safety limits
USB, LAN, and digital IO interfaces for full remote control
applications: Powering op-amps, microcontrollers, and logic circuits
Product stress testing and voltage sweeps
advantages: Linear topology ensures virtually zero high-frequency switching noise
Independent isolation allows channels to be connected in series or parallel
Bright 3.5 inch color display shows real-time V/A/W graphs

value.name: Dual-Channel Arbitrary Function Generator
value.description: 30MHz DDS signal generator with dual output channels, 150MSa/s sample rate, and built-in standard and arbitrary waveforms.

introduction.overview: The Siglent SDG1032X is a dual-channel function/arbitrary waveform generator. Using innovative EasyPulse technology, it produces stable, low-jitter square waves and pulses up to 30MHz. Perfect for simulating sensor inputs, clock signals, and testing filters.
introduction.purpose: Generate predictable, repeatable periodic electrical waveforms (sine, square, triangle, noise, etc.) to inject into a test circuit.
features: Dual independent channels with copy/tracking settings
Maximum output frequency of 30 MHz
150 MSa/s sampling rate with 14-bit vertical resolution
EasyPulse technology preserves fast rise/fall edges even at low frequency
Includes sweep, burst, and multiple modulation types (AM, FM, PM, PWM)
applications: Simulating complex sensor signals for microcontrollers
Testing frequency response of amplifiers and passive filters
Generating clock references for digital communication circuits
advantages: Dual channels allow running two phase-aligned signals simultaneously
Arbitrary shape editing software included to draw custom waves
High frequency stability and low distortion output

specifications.Standard Waveforms: Sine, Square, Ramp, Pulse, Noise, DC, Arb
specifications.Modulation Types: AM, FM, PM, ASK, FSK, PSK, PWM, Sweep, Burst

value.name: High-Speed 16-Channel Logic Analyzer
value.description: Premium USB-based 16-channel logic analyzer and mixed-signal recorder. Captures digital and analog signals with state-of-the-art software.

introduction.overview: The Saleae Logic Pro 16 is a USB-based digital diagnostic tool. Designed for embedded systems developers, it records digital lines and analog signals side-by-side. The cross-platform Saleae Logic software automatically decodes SPI, I2C, CAN, USB, and 20+ other communication protocols.
introduction.purpose: Capture and debug high-speed digital state transactions and analog voltage levels on microchip interfaces.
features: 16 digital channels plus 16 analog channels (shared inputs)
Captures digital signals up to 500 MSa/s
Captures analog signals up to 50 MSa/s with 12-bit ADC
USB 3.0 SuperSpeed connection for streaming unlimited data to PC
Aluminum enclosure for excellent shielding and durability
applications: Analyzing microsecond timing errors on SPI/I2C/CAN buses
Monitoring analog voltages of ADC/DAC circuits
advantages: Extremely intuitive software makes searching millions of samples instant
Compact pocket-sized design powered fully by USB
Supports Windows, macOS, and Linux out of the box

value.name: True-RMS AC/DC Clamp Meter
value.description: Rugged AC/DC clamp meter for commercial and residential electricians. Measures current up to 400A without breaking the circuit.

introduction.overview: The Fluke 325 is a True-RMS clamp meter designed for commercial and residential electricians. Featuring a slim jaw profile, it allows easy access in crowded cable panels and measures AC/DC current, voltage, frequency, and temperature.
introduction.purpose: Safely measure high electrical currents in active conductors without physically breaking or cutting the wire loop.
features: AC/DC current measurement up to 400 A
AC/DC voltage measurement up to 600 V
True-RMS sensing for accurate readings on distorted waveforms
Resistance measurement up to 40 k-Ohms with continuity test
Large backlight display and Min/Max recording values
applications: Measuring motor load currents in HVAC systems
Measuring charging currents on solar and battery banks
advantages: Jaw opening accommodates cables up to 30mm diameter
Includes Type-K thermocouple for quick temperature checks
Slim, compact body fits comfortably in pocket or tool pouch

value.name: Autonomous Arduino Robotics Starter Kit
value.description: Complete educational DIY robotics kit based on Arduino Uno. Build an obstacle-avoiding, Bluetooth-controlled 2WD vehicle.

introduction.overview: Unleash your inner robotics engineer with this comprehensive Arduino Robotics Starter Kit. It contains all the parts, sensors, and structural chassis components to build your own intelligent mobile robot. Step-by-step interactive lessons guide you through assembly and coding.
introduction.purpose: Learn core concepts of firmware programming, sensor integration, motor speed control, and autonomous decision-making algorithms.
features: Includes Arduino Uno R3 compatible microcontroller board
Laser-cut durable acrylic dual-deck chassis
Ultrasonic distance sensor with micro servo mount for panning
L298N Dual H-bridge motor driver module
Bluetooth transceiver for smartphone application control
applications: STEM and high school educational projects
Algorithmic maze solving and obstacle routing
advantages: No soldering required – uses clean plug-and-play breadboard wiring
Fully open-source code templates provided
Expandable chassis with mounting holes for custom add-on sensors

value.name: Zigbee Smart Home IoT Learning Kit
value.description: Explore IoT (Internet of Things) with this ESP32 & Zigbee sensor development kit. Create custom smart home monitors and alerts.

introduction.overview: The Smart Home IoT Learning Kit lets you build and program real-world smart home systems. Featuring an ESP32 microchip with dual-core processor and wireless capabilities, it communicates with DHT22 temperature sensors, flame detectors, gas sensors, and relays. Hook it up to open-source Home Assistant or write custom MQTT servers.
introduction.purpose: Learn to fetch real-world sensor data, transmit it wirelessly, and control appliances using relays and mobile apps.
features: ESP32-WROOM development board with built-in Wi-Fi & BLE
Sensors for Temperature, Humidity, Soil Moisture, and Gas Leakage
5V electromagnetic relay module to trigger high-voltage appliances safely
Detailed tutorials for configuring MQTT, Home Assistant, and ESPHome
1602 LCD character display with I2C interface
applications: Fire and gas leak detection warning systems
Smart lighting triggers and automatic curtain timers
advantages: Wi-Fi and Bluetooth allow direct smartphone connections without hubs
Sensors use I2C/SPI pins keeping breadboard routing neat
Comes with pre-configured dashboard webserver templates

specifications.Wireless Protocol: Wi-Fi 802.11 b/g/n, Bluetooth v4.2 BR/EDR & BLE

value.name: Smart Line-Following Robot Kit
value.description: An infrared sensor-based line tracker robot kit. Learn PID controller logic and calibration procedures.

introduction.overview: The Adafruit Line-Following Robot Kit is designed to teach PID (Proportional-Integral-Derivative) control systems. Featuring a multi-channel infrared sensor array and high-efficiency micro-metal gearmotors, it tracks complex tracks, intersecting curves, and sharp angles with high agility.
introduction.purpose: Calibrate infrared sensors and implement a control loop to guide a robot vehicle along a dark track on a light surface.
features: 5-Channel high-sensitivity IR sensor array for high-accuracy tracking
TB6612FNG Dual DC Motor Driver for smooth speed control
Compact circular chassis ideal for spinning on its center point
Pre-written calibration script with autotuning options
High-performance micro-metal gearmotors with metal shafts
applications: Learning feedback loops and control theory
advantages: Metal gearmotors offer significantly better torque and reliability than plastic equivalents
Onboard power switch saves battery when downloading firmware
Lightweight construction enables high-speed track navigation

value.name: ESP32 Weather Station & IoT Kit
value.description: Build an internet-connected weather monitoring station with Barometric Pressure, Temp, Humidity, and OLED display.

introduction.overview: The SparkFun Weather Station & IoT Kit is a full sensor dashboard kit. It is centered around a powerful ESP32 board and features the BME280 environmental sensor. Capture atmospheric pressure, altitude, humidity, and temperature. Send data automatically to cloud services like ThingSpeak or Adafruit IO, and display local data on a bright 0.96 inch OLED.
introduction.purpose: Acquire high-precision weather parameters and publish them to cloud IoT databases.
features: ESP32 IoT board with integrated LiPo charging circuit
High-accuracy BME280 sensor (Temp, Humidity, Pressure, Altitude)
0.96" 128x64 pixels Blue OLED display (I2C)
Pre-written code for cloud posting and energy-saving deep sleep
SparkFun Qwiic connectors for solderless daisy-chain hookup
applications: Home microclimate and ambient weather loggers
IoT cloud telemetry and charting research
advantages: Uses Qwiic connect system for absolute plug-and-play assembly
Deep sleep programming code drops power consumption to under 15 µA
Ready-made ThingSpeak dashboards with open API access templates

value.name: DIY FM Radio Soldering PCB Kit
value.description: Start your soldering journey! Assemble a portable, functional FM radio tuner with digital search and speaker output.

introduction.overview: The DIY FM Radio Soldering PCB Kit is the ultimate project for learning how to solder. The circuit features an RDA5807 FM radio receiver chip, a power amplifier, and tact buttons for scan/volume control. All components are through-hole, making soldering straightforward.
introduction.purpose: Practice through-hole soldering techniques and build a working analog/digital radio.
features: High quality silkscreened PCB with clear component mapping outlines
RDA5807 FM radio receiver chip with auto search scan
Built-in LM386 low voltage audio power amplifier
Includes miniature 8-ohm 0.5W speaker
Powered by standard 2x AA batteries
advantages: Extremely detailed soldering manual with photographic steps
Wide pads and tracing lines prevents accidental solder bridges
Gives you a fully operational radio to listen to after completion
